learnings.question: What cumulative percentage of the total text of the Quran is comprised by its top 20 most frequently occurring words?
learnings.learning: Although one might expect the 80/20 Pareto Principle to apply to vocabulary, the top 20 most frequent words in the Quran actually make up only about 20.83% of the total text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: According to 1880s research by Hermann Ebbinghaus, approximately what percentage of learned information do people forget within 24 hours without active recall?
learnings.learning: In the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus demonstrated that people forget about 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which ceremony serves as the meeting where the team demonstrates completed work to the Product Owner and discusses improvements for future Sprints?
learnings.learning: During the Sprint Review ceremony, the Scrum team demonstrates completed work to the Product Owner, reflects on the Sprint, and discusses improvements for future Sprints.

learnings.question: In Islamic teachings, what three primary roles define the overall purpose of human life?
options: Seeking material wealth, achieving social status, and mastering philosophy
Worshiping Allah, serving as caretakers (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter
Conquering foreign territories, accumulating artifacts, and avoiding community leadership
Renouncing all worldly actions, living in isolation, and practicing strict silence
learnings.learning: In Islamic belief, life is a purposeful journey centered on three key roles: worshiping Allah, serving as caretakers (khalifah) of creation, and preparing for the eternal Hereafter through a test of faith and conduct.

learnings.question: Which PCIe power management state offers the highest power savings and requires the longest wake-up time during extended periods of inactivity?
learnings.learning: Within PCIe power management, the L2 state represents the deepest sleep state where the device is almost completely powered down, yielding the maximum power savings alongside the longest wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe
